answer: With a Bug report with a fix passing automated tests backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the bug report with a fix is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. One fable proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of accepted work. A spiral and a ripple may look alike, but only the identity with consistently accepted work is honoured.
